associations.description: A vivid sunshine-yellow chair, as soft and padded as a beanbag, raised on visible wooden legs. An adult sinks into the cushions, smiling and visibly relaxing. A warm, playful room with a small music player in the background: everything feels easy.
associations.alt: An adult relaxes deeply in a bright yellow, beanbag-shaped chair on four wooden legs, with a small radio and a musical note nearby.

associations.description: An enormous open hardback book becomes a wearable shoe. Cream pages curl around a visible socked foot, bright coral laces thread through the turquoise cover, and an adult takes a playful step through a sunlit library. The impossible book-shoe links the meaning of 书 to “shoe”, an approximate sound cue for shū; the Mandarin pronunciation and first tone stay separate.
associations.alt: An adult steps through a warm library wearing an enormous turquoise hardback book as a shoe, with cream pages around a socked foot and coral laces through the cover.

definitions: newton (abbr. for 牛頓|牛顿[niu2 dun4])

associations.description: A proud black-and-white cow struts through a sunny meadow in four sparkling, brand-new turquoise and coral sneakers, one on each hoof. An open shoebox and fresh tissue paper lie beside it. The cow showing off something new connects 牛 to “new”, an approximate sound cue for niú; the real Mandarin pronunciation and rising tone remain separate.
associations.alt: A smiling black-and-white cow raises one front hoof to show off its four pristine turquoise and coral sneakers, beside an open shoebox and tissue paper in a sunny meadow.

definitions: generic term for a sacrifice to the gods

associations.description: A radiant golden sun floats on the left and a luminous silver crescent moon floats on the right, clearly separated and side by side in a cozy room. Together they wash the floor and furnishings in brilliant golden and silvery light, banishing the darkness. Remember 明, bright, by picturing its visible 日 (sun) and 月 (moon) components shining together. This is a visual component mnemonic, not an etymology claim.
associations.alt: A glowing golden sun on the left and a separate silver crescent moon on the right hover side by side, flooding a cozy room with golden and silvery light.
